Property & Owner Profile

Manage Properties

Manage Rooms

Room numbers (and optional Room Names) for — used on the Room Availability board.

Manage Rates & Charges

Set prices for breakfast, extra beds, and other add-on charges for . Changes save automatically as you type. These show up as selectable Extra Charges when creating or editing a booking, so front desk can apply the correct amount every time.

Tax Settings

Applies a tax breakdown to the Grand Total on bookings and official receipts, for both Private and Government transactions. Mark an individual booking "Tax Exempt" if it has a valid exemption.

GCash QR Payment

Let guests scan a GCash QR code to pay directly. Upload your official static GCash QR code image for the most reliable results, or leave it blank to auto-generate one from your GCash number.

Users & Access Levels

Account & Security

Change the username and password used to sign in to this dashboard on the login screen.

Cloud Sync — Multi-Device

Your hotel's data syncs to the cloud automatically for every signed-in staff member. Sign in on any phone, tablet, or PC and you'll see the same bookings, payments, and room status, updating in real time. Data still saves on the device first, so everything keeps working if the internet drops.

Not connected — this device only

Data Management

Export your bookings and payments as a CSV file for spreadsheets/reports, or download a complete backup of everything (settings, bookings, rates, POS sales, events, guests) for disaster recovery.
